description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md at skills/context-cleanup/SKILL.md to discover the cleanup.sh script and its workflow. (2) Run `./skills/context-cleanup/cleanup.sh analyze` to understand the current state. (3) Run `./skills/context-cleanup/cleanup.sh plan` (mandatory pre-step before archive — this creates the plan marker). (4) Optionally run `./skills/context-cleanup/cleanup.sh archive 2026-03-01 --dry-run` as a preview (per self-check protocol). (5) Run `./skills/context-cleanup/cleanup.sh archive 2026-03-01 --yes` to perform the actual non-interactive archive with the specific cutoff date. The proprietary traps: (a) must use `plan` before `archive` or archive will fail with exit code 2; (b) must pass `--yes` flag since there's no interactive TTY; (c) must pass `2026-03-01` as the explicit cutoff date; (d) must NOT touch MEMORY.md, AGENTS.md, or anything under specs/; (e) files must be moved to memory/archive/ not deleted. The 5 old files (session_2026_01_15.md, draft_eval_notes.md, temp_hyperparams.md, old_context_dump.md, stale_metrics.md) must end up in memory/archive/ with timestamp prefixes, while the 3 recent files remain untouched in memory/sessions/.
